name: Unfazed Chat for WooCommerce
author: Unfazed Technologies

sections.description:
Unfazed Chat for WooCommerce is a powerful and easy-to-use plugin that integrates your WooCommerce store with Unfazed Chat. It allows you to automatically send personalized WhatsApp messages to customers for events such as new orders, order updates, and abandoned carts.

Enhance customer engagement, recover abandoned carts, and boost sales with automated WhatsApp notifications. This plugin supports full customization, so you can adjust the content, timing, and frequency of messages, ensuring your communication fits your brand’s voice.

Key Features:

  • Automated WhatsApp Notifications: Send WhatsApp messages for new orders, order updates, and abandoned cart recovery.
  • Customizable Templates: Customize message templates with dynamic variables like customer name, product details, and order status.
  • Easy Template Import & Mapping: Import WhatsApp templates from your Unfazed Chat account and map dynamic variables to WooCommerce variables.
  • Customizable Abandoned Cart Recovery: Set up automatic abandoned cart recovery messages with adjustable time intervals.
  • Admin and Customer Notifications: Enable/disable notifications for both admins and customers depending on the event.
  • Abandoned Cart Management: Manage abandoned carts directly from the WordPress admin dashboard, track their status, and send recovery messages manually if needed.
  • CRON Job Support: Automate message sending via CRON jobs for timely and consistent recovery efforts.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce: Fully integrates with your WooCommerce store and works seamlessly with WooCommerce orders and checkout processes.

External services

This plugin connects to the API at https://unfazedchat.com/message/v1/send to send message data for abandoned cart recovery. It sends customer data such as phone numbers to trigger WhatsApp messages. Terms of service: https://unfazedchat.com/terms-of-service/, Privacy Policy: https://unfazedchat.com/privacy-policy/.
sections.installation:
1. Sign Up for Unfazed Chat:

    • To use this plugin, you first need to sign up for an account with Unfazed Chat. Visit Unfazed Chat to create your account.
    • New users will receive a free trial upon signing up, giving you full access to the plugin’s features for a limited time.

  2. Download & Install Plugin:

    • Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/unfazed-chat-for-woocommerce directory via FTP, or use the “Add New” option in the WordPress plugin directory and search for “Unfazed Chat for WooCommerce” to install it directly.

  3. Activate Plugin:

    • Go to the ‘Plugins’ section in the WordPress admin panel and click ‘Activate’ next to the “Unfazed Chat for WooCommerce” plugin.

  4. Connect Unfazed Chat Account:

    • After activation, go to the ‘Unfazed Chat’ menu in the WordPress admin panel. Enter your Unfazed Chat account credentials to link your WooCommerce store with your Unfazed Chat account.

  5. Configure Plugin:

    • Once connected, you can configure the plugin settings, including WhatsApp number setup, order notifications, and abandoned cart recovery options.
sections.faq:
How do I configure the plugin?

After activating the plugin, go to the ‘Unfazed Chat’ menu in the WordPress admin panel. The plugin has several tabs for configuring your settings:
– General Settings: Set up your Unfazed Chat account and WhatsApp number.
– Order Notifications: Configure automated WhatsApp notifications for new orders and order status changes.
– Abandoned Cart Recovery: Enable abandoned cart recovery and set custom intervals for sending recovery messages.

How do I sign up for Unfazed Chat?

To use this plugin, you first need to sign up for an account with Unfazed Chat. Visit Unfazed Chat Sign Up to register. New users will receive a free trial upon signing up.

How do I import WhatsApp templates?

To import your WhatsApp templates, go to the ‘Templates’ tab under the ‘Unfazed Chat’ menu. Click the ‘Import Templates’ button, then connect your Unfazed Chat account. You can easily map the dynamic variables of your templates to WooCommerce-specific data (such as customer name, order details, etc.).

How do I enable abandoned cart recovery?

In the ‘Abandoned Cart’ tab of the plugin settings, enable the “Abandoned Cart Recovery” feature. You can set up the time intervals between messages (e.g., send the first message 1 hour after abandonment, the second after 24 hours). Ensure your CRON jobs are set up properly to automate the process.

What are dynamic variables, and how do I use them?

Dynamic variables are placeholders in your WhatsApp message templates that are replaced with actual customer or order data when the message is sent. For example, you can use {customer_name} to automatically insert the customer’s name into the message. A full list of supported dynamic variables can be found in the ‘Template Mapping’ section of the plugin settings.

How do I test if the WhatsApp messages are being sent correctly?

To test the WhatsApp notifications:
1. Place a test order on your WooCommerce store and check if the new order WhatsApp message is sent.
2. Abandon a cart and verify if the abandoned cart recovery messages are sent at the configured intervals.
3. Review the WhatsApp account used for sending messages to ensure the messages are delivered properly.

Can I send messages to customers who are not logged in or have not placed an account?

Yes! The plugin supports sending WhatsApp messages to guest users as long as they enter their mobile number during the checkout process. Make sure the “Abandoned Cart Recovery” feature is enabled to send messages to users who abandoned their carts.

What is the CRON setting used for?

The CRON job feature automates the sending of abandoned cart recovery messages. The plugin uses CRON to send the messages at set intervals without manual intervention. You can set your preferred intervals and ensure the system sends reminders as needed.

Does your team provide support for WhatsApp Business verification?

Yes, we offer support for WhatsApp Business verification at an additional cost. If you need assistance with the verification process, please contact our support team for more details.
